generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The bidder should have executed as a prime contractor who carried out Design, Manufacture, Supply, Installation, Testing & Commissioning of 220V/1285Ah or higher capacity battery bank supplied to any Industry/Thermal power plants for an amount not less than Rs. 107 Lakhs (Exclusive of GST) in any one of the preceding five financial years (2021-22 to 2025-26) and should upload the Work order & relevant Work done certificate issued by the competent authority not below the rank of Chief Engineer or Head of the Project. Work done value for previous years will be given weightage of 10% per year (Maximum 50% only) to bring them to the present price level of the financial year in which the tender is invited. The intending bidder shall submit the work order and relevant work done certificate as a documentary proof issued by the Competent Authority. On demand original shall be produced for verification.
